claim.claim-text: 1. A method of providing a hydrocarbon polymer from a hydrocarbon mixture, the hydrocarbon mixture comprising a cyclic olefin, the method comprising:
, Li<+>, Na<+>, K<+>, Ca<2+> and a combination thereof.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein polymerization of the cyclic olefin is by ring-opening metathesis polymerization for synthesizing a functional polymer.
3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the cyclic olefin is cyclooctene, cyclooctadiene, cyclooctatriene, cyclooctatetraene or cyclododecatriene.

4. The method of anyone of the preceding claims, wherein the hydrocarbon mixture comprising a cyclic olefin is a hydrocarbon mixture comprising an eight-membered monocyclic unsaturated hydrocarbon and additional nonlinear unsaturated C<8>H<2m> hydrocarbons with 4≤m≤8, wherein the contacting the hydrocarbon mixture with a 10-ring pore molecular sieve at a temperature of -20°C to 60 °C for a time and under conditions is to provide a sieved hydrocarbon mixture comprising the eight-membered monocyclic unsaturated hydrocarbon at a separation concentration Cs ≥ 99.3 % wt; and wherein the contacting the sieved hydrocarbon mixture with a polymerization catalyst for a time and under conditions is to polymerize the eight-membered monocyclic unsaturated hydrocarbon.
5. The method of claim 4, wherein the eight-membered monocyclic unsaturated hydrocarbon has one, two, three or four double bonds or one or two triple bonds.
6. The method of claim 4 or claim 5, wherein the eight-membered monocyclic unsaturated hydrocarbon is one or more of compounds 1 to 10
7. The method of claim 6, wherein the eight-membered monocyclic unsaturated hydrocarbon is compound 1 and/or 2
preferably the contacting is performed to provide a copolymer of compounds 1 and 2.

8. The method of any one of claims 4 to 7, wherein the sieved hydrocarbon mixture comprises the eight-membered monocyclic unsaturated hydrocarbon at a separation concentration of at least 99.5 % wt, preferably at least 99.7 % wt or at least 99.8 % wt or at least 99.9 % wt.

9. The method of any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the hydrocarbon mixture is split and fed into more than one continuous polymerization reactors to perform multi-stage polymerization reactions of sieved unsaturated hydrocarbons, in particular sieved cycloolefins.
10. The method of claim 9, wherein the sieved unsaturated cycloolefins comprise sieved cis, cis-1,5-cyclooctadiene (COD) and/or sieved cyclooctene.

11. The method of any one of claims 4 to 10, wherein polymerization of the eight-membered monocyclic unsaturated hydrocarbon is by ring opening metathesis polymerization of cis, cis-1,5-cyclooctadiene (COD) in the presence of a functional chain-transfer agent (CTA).
12. A hydrocarbon polymer obtainable from the method of any one of claims 1 to 11.

13. A hydrocarbon polymer according to claim 13, which is obtainable by ring opening metathesis polymerization of cis, cis-1,5-cyclooctadiene (COD) in the presence of a functional chain-transfer agent (CTA).
14. A hydrocarbon polymer according to claim 13 or 14, obtainable by polymerization of sieved cis, cis-1,5-cyclooctadiene (COD) and/or sieved cyclooctene.
15. A hydrocarbon polymer according to any one of claims 10 to 14, which is a copolymer of compounds 1 and 2:
